content.text:
=== frontend config tells browser OIDC authority ===
window._env_ = {"VITE_AUTH_BYPASS":"false","VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY":"http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution","VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID":"frontend"};
=== can a browser on this host resolve auth.localhost? (same /etc/hosts) ===
NO RESOLUTION -> login redirect unreachable from this host too
=== protected /api/v1/info/services is behind auth -> 503 even with valid token ===
{"error":"identity provider unavailable","code":"auth.idp_unavailable"} [503]

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== frontend config tells browser OIDC authority ==="; curl -s -m 8 http://localhost:3000/api/config.js
echo "=== can a browser on this host resolve auth.localhost? (same /etc/hosts) ==="; getent hosts auth.localhost || echo "NO RESOLUTION -> login redirect unreachable from this host too"
echo "=== protected /api/v1/info/services is behind auth -> 503 even with valid token ==="
TOK=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: auth.localhost" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=backend&client_secret=cVBGgWNlbwSLydLZfZMvTvmNCeiSmLGP" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).access_token))")
curl -s -m 20 -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/info/services
